title: Computer Science
tagline: Build the systems that power the modern world, from first principles to artificial intelligence.
overview:
The Certificate in Computer Science is a rigorous, three-year course of study devoted entirely to computing. You begin by learning to program alongside the discrete mathematics, calculus, probability, and linear algebra that underpin the discipline, then build a deep core in data structures and algorithms, computer architecture, operating systems, networks, databases, and software engineering.

In your final year you study distributed systems and artificial intelligence, complete a four-course concentration in AI and data science, software engineering and the cloud, or cybersecurity, and finish with a two-term capstone in which you design and deliver a substantial project of your own.
outcomes: Design, implement, and test correct, efficient, and maintainable software in multiple languages.
Analyze problems mathematically and select appropriate data structures and algorithms.
Explain how computer systems work, from hardware and operating systems to networks and distributed services.
Apply machine learning and AI techniques responsibly, with an understanding of their limits.
Work effectively on software teams using modern engineering practices.
Evaluate the ethical, legal, and social implications of computing.
